purpose: Avoid counting same original human cohort/artifact as independent cross-experiment replication.
identity_rules: Exact original file DOI equality means same source asset, regardless of research ID.
Exact original dataset DOI equality requires checking filename, experiment assignment and cohort overlap: a dataset repository may contain different experimental cohorts.
Same researcher/coauthor does not alone mean same participants. Different source DOI does not alone prove disjoint participants.
Only verified actual source file SHA supports byte identity. Preserve E0/E1/E2 distinction.
